title: Mushroom 'Meat' Ragu
subtitle: with Penne, Oregano and Garlic Bread
description: It’s plant power all the way with our super-tasty vegan dishes! Our meat-free, dairy-free, honey-free dishes are amped with plant-based proteins, fresh produce, nuts and seeds. Best of all, they’re for everyone, whether you’re vegan, vegetarian or flexitarian.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a medium saucepan of salted water to the boil for the pasta. Finely chop the onion. Finely chop the oregano leaves, discarding the stems (see Make it yours). Crush or finely chop the garlic.
Cook pasta: Cook the pasta in the pan of boiling water for 10 mins or until al dente. Reserve 60ml (¼ cup) cooking water, then drain the pasta.

Brown mushroom meat: Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Heat 3 tsp olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the onion and garlic, stirring, for 3 mins or until softened. Add the mushroom meat and Italian seasoning and cook, stirring constantly and breaking up the lumps with a spoon, for 3 mins or until browned.

Simmer ragu: Add the tomatoes, reserved cooking water, half the tomato paste, 1 tbs soy sauce and 2 tsp sugar to the mushroom meat mixture and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook for 15 mins or until slightly thickened. While the ragu is cooking, put the garlic bread on an oven tray, butter-side up, and bake for 6 mins or until golden and crunchy.

Serve up: Add the pasta and oregano to the ragu and cook, stirring, for 2 mins or until warmed through. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the ragu pasta among bowls and serve with the garlic bread. Enjoy!
Make it yours: Reserve a few oregano sprigs if you like the rustic look in our photo, then scatter over the ragu before serving.
